modules.title: Introduction to Nghọta na Edemede (Comprehension and Composition)
modules.html:
Igbo reading comprehension, essay writing and translation. This section covers introduction to nghọta na edemede (comprehension and composition).

Key points

  • Mkpụrụedemede Igbo ole bụ mgbochiume (Consonants) — Iri abụọ na asatọ.
  • Olee n'ime mkpụrụedemede ndị a bụ mgbochiume kpachịrị akpachị (Digraphs) — gb, ch, gh.
  • Olee akara edemede a na-eji egosi nkwụsị oge na mkparịtaụka — Kọma.
  • Gịnị bụ nghọta akpalaokwu a: 'Ịta nchara' — Ịta ahụhụ/Ịda ogbenye.
  • Olee onye kacha ama ama n'ide edemede egwuregwu (Drama) n'asụsụ Igbo — Goddy Onyekaonwu.

Worked examples

Q: Mkpụrụedemede Igbo ole bụ mgbochiume (Consonants)?
A: Iri abụọ na asatọ — Out of 36 letters, 28 are consonants (mgbochiume).

Q: Olee n'ime mkpụrụedemede ndị a bụ mgbochiume kpachịrị akpachị (Digraphs)?
A: gb, ch, gh — Digraphs are sounds represented by two letters but producing a single sound, such as 'gb', 'ch', 'gh', 'kw', 'nw', 'ny', 'sh'.

examples.q: Olee n'ime mkpụrụedemede ndị a bụ mgbochiume kpachịrị akpachị (Digraphs)?

quiz.q: Mkpụrụedemede Igbo ole bụ mgbochiume (Consonants)?
Olee n'ime mkpụrụedemede ndị a bụ mgbochiume kpachịrị akpachị (Digraphs)?
quiz.solution: Digraphs are sounds represented by two letters but producing a single sound, such as 'gb', 'ch', 'gh', 'kw', 'nw', 'ny', 'sh'.

quiz.q: Olee akara edemede a na-eji egosi nkwụsị oge na mkparịtaụka?
quiz.solution: A comma (kọma) is used to indicate a brief pause in a sentence or dialogue.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ nghọta akpalaokwu a: 'Ịta nchara'?
quiz.solution: 'Ịta nchara' means to suffer or live in extreme poverty.

quiz.q: Olee onye kacha ama ama n'ide edemede egwuregwu (Drama) n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Goddy Onyekaonwu is a notable Igbo playwright (writer of drama).

quiz.q: Mkpụrụedemede asụsụ Igbo dị ole n'ọnụọgụ?
quiz.solution: The Standard Igbo alphabet (Abidịị) consists of 36 letters.

quiz.q: Olee mkpụrụedemede bụ myiriụda (Nasal consonant acting as a syllable)?
quiz.solution: 'm' and 'n' are nasal sounds that can function as syllables in Igbo words like 'mma' or 'nna'.

quiz.q: Mkpụrụ edemede Igbo ole bụ ụdaume (vowels)?
Olee mkpụrụ edemede a na-akpọ 'ụda imi'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: m, n.

quiz.q: Olee n'ime mkpụrụ edemede a bụ konsonanti?
Kedu n'ime ndị a bụ mkpụrụ edemede nsupe 'Akwụkwọ'?
options: a, k, w, ụ, k, w, ọ
e, k, w, u, k, w, o
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: a, k, w, ụ, k, w, ọ.

quiz.q: Olee mkpụrụ edemede kacha nso na 'GB'?
Olee n'ime mkpụrụ edemede a bụ 'A'?

Gịnị bụ 'Sit'?
Kedu ihe bụ 'Iri Ji'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: New Yam Festival.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Mmiri'?
Kedu nke bụ 'Tebulu'?
Wanne ne jam'in kalmar 'Gida'?
Wanene ya rubuta littafin 'Magana Jari Ce'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Abubakar Imam.

quiz.q: Menene 'Daurin Aure'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Wedding solemnization.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Uba'?
Cika: 'Ladan aiki ...'
Olee nri kacha mkpa n'ala Igbo?
Olee akara e ji amata ụdaolu (Tones)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Akara elu, ala na n'etiti.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe bụ nsonaazụ (suffix) na 'riri'?
Gịnị bụ 'Egwuregwu onye' (Drama)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Egwuregwu n'elu ikpo okwu.
